units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A locked-off medium close-up at the display glass, and the framing stays exactly as the first frame. A young woman in a cream knit sweater stands in profile at a museum vitrine after closing; a carved stone relief sits dimly behind the glass; warm tungsten halogen from the case lights the near side of her face at 3000K while the room falls to warm black. At the start she is still and her eyes travel slowly along a single carved line on the relief. Around one second she blinks once, unhurried: the lids close over about seven frames and open again, and after that her gaze lifts a little to hold her own faint reflection in the glass, where it stays. Late in the take her shoulders settle as she lets one breath out. Her head stays almost still, her jaw still, her mouth closed and soft, and only her eyes, her eyelids and that small shoulder settle move. Fine 35mm grain, warm halation along the glass edge, black point slightly lifted, skin kept warm and natural, the same museum hall and the same lighting as the first frame.
